d:
What exactly did the number 13 do to deserve this kind of reputation? And why has Friday been dragged into the whole mess? A little religion, a little mythology, a medieval massacre and of course, Hollywood for a bit of drama. Hem Kaur Saroya explains if it is actually a day of bad luck or just centuries of bad PR.
